Honest verdict in the artifact: within a strict 30 km radius of Dal Pescatore there are **no general-purpose IT conferences in 2026**. Cremona sits right on the boundary (31 km) and is the only realistic hub — chiefly Politecnico di Milano's Cremona campus and CremonaFiere events (Cremona Musica with 3D-printing-in-lutherie, agritech livestock expo). Mantova is just outside (39 km road). For real developer/IT conferences, the closest options require driving to Milan (~120 km), Bologna, or Verona.
